allowlisted.justification: The frozen LibreOffice PDF serializes `https://example.com/`; the source and local engine serialize `https://example.com`. URI normalization proves both navigate to the exact `https://example.com` origin target.
allowlisted.user_visible_effect: The link reaches the same origin, but its serialized PDF URI differs from the legacy output.

allowlisted.justification: The frozen LibreOffice goldens rendered these pageSetup-less sheets on LibreOffice's own A4 default (595.3x841.9pt). ECMA-376 18.3.1.63 defines paperSize default 1 (US Letter, 612x792pt), which Excel applies; the engine now follows the spec, so the page dimensions legitimately diverge from the A4-era goldens.
allowlisted.user_visible_effect: Pages print on US Letter instead of A4 for workbooks that declare no pageSetup, matching Excel's default; content per page shifts accordingly versus the frozen LibreOffice rendering.
